# Windows wheel bootstrap fixtures

These inert source fixtures are the original, byte-pinned Windows wheel files used to verify the approved private DLL loader profiles. Tests never import or execute them. Their full-file SHA256 is intentionally significant; retain their original CRLF bytes.

Cohort: NumPy2.5.3, MLdtypes0.6.0, ONNXweekly1.24.0.dev20260914, scikit-learn1.9.1, Torch2.4.1, TorchDirectML0.2.5.dev240914, SciPy and llvmlite0.49.0/TorchVision (their source/installed metadata is retained in the original readback). Original package licenses and notices are retained beside the sources. Structural PE and RECORD fixtures created by tests are synthetic and establish no native execution or redistribution rights.
